preservedDirtyInput: QC_Renderer.asset was rendered with the user’s original uncommitted configuration; its SHA-256 is recorded, its bytes were preserved and it is excluded from commits.

vegetationClearance.method: Independent pair distances, 32-point crown/river checks, oriented architecture and owned road surfaces

limits: Indexed vertex/payload and Editor counters are not GPU timing or phone FPS.
Water and airborne pollen are transparent and do not cast opaque ground shadows.
shadows.tierTotalsScope: Sum across all five chunks of each quality; only up to three chunks are resident. Visibility budgets are recorded separately in measurements.
shadows.comparisonMethod: Prior writer stored three vertices per triangle. Bake checks all expanded triangle attributes against the exact indexed stream.

historicalIndexingVisualProof.scope: Pixel equality applies only to the earlier indexing-only revision, not new terrain and lighting.

shadows.indexingBaseline: Expanded triangle stream of the current geometry; not a comparison to the former art revision.

depthReview.cameraComparison: Same authored XZ anchors, yaw, pitch, FOV and booms; focus Y follows the rebaked terrain. Water uses a live clock.
depthReview.refinement: Baked skirts close distant/detailed LOD edges. The first pass had an oversteep bank; a low floodplain softens it. Distant shoreline tiles are refined offline instead of omitted; identical bed heights avoid a depth-colour seam at chunk boundaries.
